question: The fifth Khelo India Youth Games was hosted by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The fifth edition of the **Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG)** was hosted by **Madhya Pradesh** in 2023.
 
• It was held across multiple cities in Madhya Pradesh including **Bhopal, Indore, Gwalior, and Jabalpur**.
 
• The event witnessed participation from over **6,000 athletes** representing different states and union territories of India.
 
• Sports competitions included **27 disciplines**, such as archery, athletics, swimming, and hockey, among others.
 
• The Khelo India initiative, launched by the Government of India, aims to **promote grassroots-level sports** and identify young talent for future international competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Programme**

 
 
• Launched in 2018 by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, this program focuses on **reviving the sports culture in India at the grassroots level**.
 
• It aims to provide financial assistance, infrastructure development, and training to young athletes.
 
• Athletes under this program are awarded scholarships and sponsorships to support their development.
 
 
 
• **Previous Hosts of Khelo India Youth Games**
 
 
• The inaugural Khelo India Youth Games was held in **New Delhi** in 2018.
 
• Subsequent editions were hosted by Pune (2019), Guwahati (2020), and Haryana (2022).
 
 
 
• **Disciplines in Khelo India Youth Games**
 
 
• Sports such as shooting, wrestling, weightlifting, gymnastics, and cycling are included in the competition.
 
• Traditional Indian sports like **kho-kho, kabaddi, and mallakhamb** are also part of the event.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Khelo India Initiative**
 
 
• The initiative has significantly increased awareness about sports and fitness among the youth.
 
• It has played a key role in scouting and nurturing young talent for international sports events, including the Olympics.
